## Problem

What gap or limitation are you hitting? Who is it for?

## Proposal

What you'd like to see. If it's a new attack category or test case, describe the
failure mode it surfaces and what a safe response looks like.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, and why this one.

## Scope

- [ ] New attack category / test cases
- [ ] Evaluator or scoring change
- [ ] Executor / target type
- [ ] UI / reporting / export
- [ ] Other
